# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, and ADUs in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. Founded 2017. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Design-build means one accountable team handles design, estimating, Ada and Canyon County permitting, and construction under one contract, backed by a written scope and a workmanship guarantee. 2026 planning ranges: kitchen remodel $35k-$75k mid-range ($75k-$150k+ full gut); bathroom remodel $18k-$45k guest ($35k-$85k+ primary); whole-home $150k-$400k+; room addition $80k-$250k+; ADU $90k-$180k garage conversion ($180k-$300k+ detached).

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/kitchen-remodel): mid-range refresh to full-gut layout changes.
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/bathroom-remodel): guest baths to primary-suite renovations.
- [Whole-Home Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/whole-home-remodel): multi-room and full-house renovations.
- [Room Addition](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/room-addition): bump-outs, second stories, and new rooms.
- [ADU / Guest House](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/adu): garage conversions and detached new builds.
- [Basement Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/basement-remodel): finished basements, egress, and lower-level living space.
- [Outdoor Living & Decks](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/outdoor-living): decks, covered patios, and outdoor kitchens.
- [Aging-in-Place Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/aging-in-place): accessible, universal-design remodels.
- [All Services](https://boiseremodeling.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boiseremodeling.co/areas).
